quote: I cannot recommend Jaimi's yoga session more highly. I hadn't practiced regular yoga for many years and was in a group with younger, more regular yoga devotees. Jaimi easily accommodated the different abilities within the group and quietly modified any movements that might have been more difficult for me over the course of the session. I came away feeling refreshed and revived and keen to get back into regular yoga!
